reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis conflates phase stability with eutectic microstructure and does not explain how V, Mo, B additions govern phase stability; the mechanism is vague and lacks a clear causal link to the claimed property improvements.
reasons.testability: The proposed test compares properties of alloyed vs. unalloyed EHEA, but the falsification criterion is too broad and does not isolate the effect on phase stability, making it a weak test of the stated hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it restates known benefits of eutectic microstructures without offering a novel, testable mechanistic insight into what governs phase stability in Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni alloys.
